'''Tiuli Anfossi Tiuli's Flawless Victory''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tiuli Anfossi]]
* '''Published:''' November 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-D-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tiuli's Flawless Victory
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Tiuli's Flawless Victory Anfossi DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Tiuli Anfossi of Toronto and her boyfriend, Andrew Liu, each submitted a deck to us. These decks were designed by two players who play against each other all the time, and as Rebel Base Leader puts it, "There's no chance of your falling asleep when these two decks are played against one another."

Divers says, "You can't go wrong - both are set on Tatooine, have lots of mains, and lots of additional cards that answer the complimentary deck blow for blow. Sit down with these decks and you'll have a heck of a game."
